## What I do

- **Research analytics:** NIH projects, publications, clinical trials, patents, and public health data
- **Data science:** Python, R, and SQL; machine learning, NLP, and LLMs; cloud deployment on GCP
- **Communication:** dashboards and executive summaries that lead with the takeaway; AI-assisted workflows with validated output

## How this portfolio works

Each skill page has one NIH flagship project, a smaller project from another domain, and earlier work. Every project starts with a plain-language question and ends with an executive summary and a log of how AI tools were used and checked. All data is public.
